assessments.reasoning: The publisher’s Chez Scheme 8.3 documentation page contains the SWL agreement and a distinct government-use paragraph between the grant and closing installation acknowledgement. The verified full-page SHA-256 is 7d7d81f91e37e3070b4e7faacef5c887f4bfe2740df6b88175c403c503d3122a. [Publisher source](https://scheme.com/csv8.3/swl-lic.html)

The committed row links the publisher page and matches its full digest and the subject key. It records the editorial title Scheme Widget Library Software License Agreement, kind license, edition swl-captured-reference, and lifecycle historical for the bounded agreement. The publisher’s heading includes the parenthetical abbreviation SWL. [Committed Index decision](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/software-commons/license-index/cffd21c29084a60c2fb00a9ee0d2c52780246c02/docs/decisions/three-project-notices-lifecycle-2026-11-28.md)

challenge.method: Recomputed SHA-256 over the full UTF-8 publisher HTML, isolated the grant through the closing installation acknowledgement, and checked that the government-use paragraph lies within those bounds. Tested whether the row encompassed the separate Chez Scheme or Petite Chez Scheme agreements.
challenge.results: The full HTML digest matched the claim and row. The bounded raw HTML occupies bytes [948,3093), with SHA-256 fa287077a7c7e54d05ad740db076e168bbebeb2f49ffda4ca0797b4f6c3b3170. It contains a separate government-use paragraph. The publisher’s separate-agreements note follows the closing acknowledgement and falls outside the cited passage.

limitations: The finding covers the captured SWL agreement and its Index lookup classification. Applicability to other works, legal equivalence, reuse, and installation require separate evidence.

Exact SPDX correspondence and any SPDX-specific SWL variants remain unverified. The supplied bindings identify neither the intended fixed SPDX representations nor an intended tag. I selected v3.29.0 for a supplemental comparison and verified the [release tag](https://github.com/spdx/license-list-data/releases/tag/v3.29.0). Requests for both the tagged SWL text and XML returned cache misses.
reasoning: The fresh publisher capture supports the agreement and government-use assertions. The committed Index decision assigns the historical lifecycle to the exact captured reference. Both assertions are supported at their stated documentary scope under SCES-1.0 and the Codex Research Protocol.
